question: The Himalayas have uplifted from which of the following geosynclines?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tethys geosynclines**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Himalayas have uplifted from the **Tethys geosynclines**.
 
• The Tethys geosyncline was a large ancient ocean that existed between the continents of Gondwana and Laurasia before the uplift of the Himalayas.
